title: A person within their circumstances
explanation: These influences interact. A person may need practical assistance, protection, healthcare, or changes in their surroundings as well as emotional support.
reflection: Optional reflectionWhich influences in this diagram require support beyond an individual’s own effort?

title: Notice the pressure. Consider the support.
explanation: Risk and protective factors do not determine an individual outcome. Institutions and communities help create many protective conditions.
reflection: Optional reflectionHow might a community or institution help create one of these protective conditions?

title: Offer care without taking away choice
explanation: Care does not require having all the answers or asking someone to disclose painful events. Support can include quiet company and help finding appropriate services.
reflection: Optional reflectionHow does asking permission give the other person more choice?

title: Example A: A learner under examination pressure.
explanation: This example connects emotional support with practical planning. A study conversation is one possible step, not a guarantee that distress will end. Persistent or worsening difficulty may need further help.
reflection: Optional reflectionWhat makes the educator’s response supportive rather than blaming?

title: Example B: A young adult facing unemployment.
explanation: Emotional connection and practical assistance can both be relevant. Unemployment is not evidence of insufficient positivity, and encouragement alone cannot remove structural barriers.
reflection: Optional reflectionWhich part of this response offers practical help as well as connection?

title: Example C: An adult managing family responsibilities.
explanation: The response changes the workload rather than asking the caregiver simply to cope better. Shared tasks are one possibility; accessible practical and health support may still be necessary.
reflection: Optional reflectionHow does sharing a task differ from telling someone to be more positive?
